highlights: Delete a message, mark it as unread, or send its text to a channel: touch and hold the message.
Link WhatsApp numbers and change Telegram and Slack triggers and outputs from your phone. The server needs the latest OpenBot.
Use the app in Arabic, with a right-to-left layout. Each chat paragraph shows in the direction of its text.
Connect Coinbase, Robinhood, RevenueCat, TickTick, Proton Pass and Higgsfield from the Apps marketplace.
The app reconnects faster when you come back to it, uses less memory while a reply streams, and closes less often.
